Key Responsibilities Coordinate with engineering teams on constructability and design issues related to commodity installations and work sequencing. Establish and maintain a working relationship and communication lines with the Project Engineer regarding piping design and field engineering, including agreement on deliverables and configuration management. Specify piping criteria for the construction of temporary facilities as required. Provide field engineering support to superintendents and personnel to meet cost and time schedules, verify materials, equipment, and quality, and ensure design requirements are met. Develop work plans, coordinate material take-offs and requisitions, perform and document inspections, report progress, and resolve design and construction conflicts for mechanical commodity installation and testing. f992d48a0af456ea.description: About the Role Fisheye - Executive Search is partnering with a leading healthcare company in Saudi Arabia to recruit a Sales Manager. f975ccc4f9d17d32.description: About the Role We're looking for an experienced, results-driven Senior Media Buyer to lead the execution and optimization of our paid advertising campaigns, with a primary focus on scaling e-commerce revenue and driving profitable growth. We're looking for someone who goes beyond managing ad spend—someone who understands the numbers, identifies growth opportunities, and makes data-driven decisions that directly impact business performance. If you've personally managed SAR 1M+ in advertising spend within a single quarter and can demonstrate the revenue and business results behind that investment, we'd like to hear from you. Key Responsibilities Campaign Management: Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, Snapchat, X, Google Ads, and Google Display Network (GDN). Budget Optimization: Own advertising budget allocation across channels, continuously reallocating spend based on performance, profitability, and growth opportunities. Media Planning: Develop quarterly media strategies supported by monthly and weekly plans, with daily campaign monitoring and optimization. E-commerce Growth: Execute full-funnel performance strategies focused on customer acquisition, retargeting, conversion optimization, and profitable revenue growth. Seasonal Campaigns: Plan and execute high-impact campaigns aligned with key retail seasons and promotional events. Creative Performance: Collaborate with creative and content teams to develop, test, and optimize ad creatives based on performance insights. Tracking & Measurement: Implement, manage, and troubleshoot conversion tracking through GTM, GA4, advertising pixels, and Meta Conversions API (CAPI). Attribution & Insights: Analyze attribution, customer journeys, and conversion funnels to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement. Omnichannel Performance: Execute Store Visits campaigns where supported and develop measurement approaches to assess the impact of digital advertising on physical store sales. Performance Reporting: Deliver actionable weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports covering ROAS, CPA, CAC, conversion rates, revenue, and overall advertising efficiency. Requirements Proven hands-on experience in media buying and performance marketing, with a strong background in e-commerce. Demonstrated experience personally managing SAR 1M+ in quarterly advertising spend , with measurable business results. Advanced proficiency in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads, and Google Ads. Proven ability to scale conversion-focused campaigns while maintaining acquisition efficiency and profitability. Strong technical knowledge of GTM, GA4, conversion tracking, advertising pixels, and Meta CAPI. Solid understanding of campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and retargeting. Strong analytical skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to turn performance data into actionable decisions. Experience in the Saudi or GCC market, preferably within fashion, retail, or e-commerce. Professional proficiency in Arabic and English. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Magento e-commerce platforms. Knowledge of server-side tracking, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing. Experience connecting online advertising performance with offline retail sales. Familiarity with CRM, email marketing, and WhatsApp marketing. Exposure to influencer marketing, Mawthooq, and marketplace advertising through Noon or Amazon. How to Apply Along with your CV, please share one paid advertising campaign you've personally managed that demonstrates your experience. Include the advertising budget, platforms used, measurable results (including revenue and ROAS), key optimization decisions, and what you would approach differently today. Brand names and confidential information may be omitted. We're looking for someone who can demonstrate not only how they manage advertising budgets, but how they turn those budgets into measurable business growth.

f92df044c6bb756b.description: About the Role Laverne Group is seeking a Recruitment Specialist to join its HR team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is primarily focused on sales recruitment and managing mass recruitment campaigns to attract qualified candidates. Key Responsibilities Manage the complete recruitment cycle, from job posting to onboarding. Source and attract candidates, primarily for sales positions. Administer and manage contracts throughout the project lifecycle, interpreting provisions and advising on contractual rights, obligations, and risks. Lead the administration of variations, change orders, compensation events, and contract amendments, including assessment, preparation, and negotiation. Manage the preparation, evaluation, and negotiation of contractual claims and Extension of Time (EOT) requests, assessing entitlement and substantiation. Support payment processes, review applications, and assist with final account negotiations and commercial settlements. Draft, review, and issue contractual notices and correspondence, ensuring compliance and maintaining records. Identify, assess, and manage contractual and commercial risks, developing mitigation strategies and promoting dispute avoidance. Act as a key client-facing representative, providing strategic contractual advice and leading negotiations with stakeholders. Support dispute avoidance initiatives and assist in formal dispute resolution processes when required. Manage contractual close-out activities, including completion, final account agreement, and documentation. Prepare regular reports on contractual status, commercial performance, claims, variations, and risks. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in managing contracts within construction projects, with specific experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams. Demonstrated experience managing post-contract services on large and complex projects. Proven experience in claims management, Extension of Time assessments, variation management, and dispute resolution. Experience in the administration of Standard and Bespoke forms of contract, including a strong working knowledge of FIDIC Contracts. Experience providing contractual and commercial advice in a client-side consultancy environment. Experience managing multiple stakeholders across multidisciplinary project teams. Skills and Attributes Proactive approach with a drive for delivery and the ability to unite stakeholders around a common vision. Ability to follow through and clearly deliver work instructions in a complex stakeholder environment. Flexibility and adaptability in responding to changing business requirements. Effective management and prioritization of workload to meet tight deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, particularly in contracts review and change management. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. This role requires a commitment to customer service excellence and the ability to deliver strong commercial results.

f953c32da8c913cd.description: نبحث عن أخصائي تسويق إلكتروني مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في نمو علامتنا التجارية عبر المنصات الرقمية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات التسويق الرقمي، وتحليل أداء الحملات، وتحسين تجربة المستخدم. إذا كنت شغوفًا بالابتكار في مجال التسويق الرقمي ولديك خبرة في الأدوات والمنصات الحديثة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. * تطوير وتنفيذ حملات التسويق عبر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، محركات البحث، والبريد الإلكتروني. * تحليل بيانات الحملات وتقديم تقارير دورية حول الأداء وقياس العائد على الاستثمار. * إدارة وتحسين المحتوى الرقمي لزيادة التفاعل والوصول إلى الجمهور المستهدف.

f9c6d41596908e64.description: About the Role Sealy Mattress Middle East is seeking a Senior Retail Sales Specialist / Executive for showroom sales. This full-time position is based in the Makkah Province, specifically across showrooms in Jeddah, Riyadh, and Dammam. The primary objective is to drive retail revenue by providing consultative sleep solutions to high-end clients and meeting sales targets for luxury products. Role Overview The Senior Retail Sales Specialist / Executive acts as a sleep expert, engaging with walk-in clients to understand their needs and recommend premium sleep systems. This role requires navigating consumer psychology within the luxury market and achieving sales objectives. Key Responsibilities Proactively engage showroom visitors to demonstrate Sealy’s Posturepedic technology, sleep systems, and luxury bedding accessories to close high-ticket sales. Evaluate individual alignment concerns, sleep habits, and body type comfort preferences to customize mattress model recommendations. Articulate luxury mattress construction materials and ergonomic health benefits to manage premium pricing discussions. Maintain showroom presentation, product formatting, and pricing clarity according to brand standards. Accurately handle Point of Sale (POS) terminals, CRM entries, and digital inventory systems for same-visit purchases. Collaborate with warehousing and delivery teams to ensure precise tracking and shipment dispatch to clients. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in retail sales, preferably within a luxury goods or high-end product environment. Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and manage client relationships. Experience with POS, CRM, and inventory management systems. Work Location This position is based in Saudi Arabia, with opportunities across various showrooms in Jeddah, Riyadh, and Dammam within the Makkah Province. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

f9e28639f5b722db.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات عن ميكانيكي تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فحص وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة تمديدات التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء لضمان كفاءتها وسلامتها التشغيلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب مكونات أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء المختلفة. تركيب الأنابيب وضبطها وربطها بشكل صحيح لضمان الأداء الأمثل. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد أي أضرار محتملة في المعدات. تصليح واستبدال الأجزاء التالفة أو البالية، واختبار المعدات بعد التصليح للتأكد من فعاليتها. حفظ السجلات الدقيقة لخدمات المعدات وعمليات التصليح التي تم إجراؤها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء التصليحات اللازمة لأنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. مهارات جيدة في تركيب وصيانة المكونات والأنابيب. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في جازان، ويتطلب التزاماً بالعمل الميداني لصيانة الأنظمة المختلفة. يعمل الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

f9f3a9cc7196133e.description: About the Role Al Tamimi & Company is seeking an Of Counsel/Senior Associate specializing in Healthcare Regulatory law. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and is focused on leading and expanding the firm's Healthcare Regulatory practice in KSA. The role involves advising clients, contributing to regulatory frameworks, and driving business development initiatives across the Kingdom. Key Responsibilities Advise on healthcare regulatory frameworks, including drafting and reviewing laws, governance processes, policies, and standards. Provide advisory support on licensing, operational compliance, and regulatory enforcement. Prepare and implement policies and procedures for healthcare facilities. Draft and review commercial contracts for public and private sector projects, including Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs). Support corporate structuring, Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), and Joint Venture (JV) due diligence from a regulatory perspective. Advise on health data, privacy, and patient consent matters. Counsel clients in the life sciences and biotech sector, covering pharmaceutical, medical device, and clinical trial regulatory matters. Represent healthcare clients in regulatory investigations and disciplinary matters (medical liability litigation is handled separately). Lead matter strategy, oversee junior colleagues, manage timelines, ensure quality control, and maintain client engagement. Drive practice growth through business development, proposal generation, and participation in sector events and conferences. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated expertise in healthcare regulatory law. Internal and External Relationships This role involves significant interaction with external clients, regulators, and government bodies. Internally, the position requires collaboration with Heads of Department, Riyadh Office leadership, cross-practice teams, Business Development, Marketing, and Knowledge Management. Equity, Diversity & Inclusion Al Tamimi & Company is committed to attracting and retaining talent from diverse backgrounds. Al Tamimi & Company provides equal opportunities for all applicants and welcomes applications from candidates with disabilities, offering support to those in the workplace who have a disability.

f90a047cd2c1a2f6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان كفاءة وسلامة أنظمة التبريد والتكييف في الحافلات، مما يساهم في راحة الركاب وجاهزية الأسطول للتشغيل. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تنفيذ أعمال الفحص والصيانة والإصلاح لأنظمة التبريد والتكييف، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يهدف الدور إلى الحفاظ على أعلى مستويات الأداء لهذه الأنظمة لضمان تجربة سفر مريحة وآمنة للركاب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في اختيار أنظمة تكييف وتهوية الحافلات المناسبة، وتقديم المشورة الفنية بشأن قطع الغيار ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم الفني في تركيب أنظمة التكييف عند الطلب، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة لأعمال التركيب والصيانة. تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والتصليح السريع لأجهزة ومكيفات الحافلات لضمان عملها بكفاءة عالية. التفتيش الفني على تشغيل أجهزة التكييف والتهوية داخل الحافلات للتأكد من سلامة التبريد ودقة الأداء ومطابقته للمواصفات. تطبيق كافة معايير وتدابير الصحة والسلامة المهنية والبيئية أثناء التعامل مع الفريون وأنظمة التبريد. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال صيانة وإصلاح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف (HVAC). معرفة قوية بأنظمة التبريد والتكييف، بما في ذلك تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية والالتزام بالتعليمات. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية والبيئية. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

f911708d7dbaa2f3.description: About the Role InterContinental Hotels Group is seeking a Butcher to join their team. This full-time position involves preparing, cutting, trimming, portioning, and storing meat, poultry, and related products according to hotel standards. The role is critical for ensuring product quality, food safety, hygiene, and minimal wastage, thereby supporting the smooth operation of the kitchen. Key Responsibilities Receive, inspect, and verify the quality, quantity, and freshness of all delivered meat, poultry, and other related products. Cut, trim, debone, portion, and prepare various types of meat according to menu requirements and chef specifications. Prepare standard cuts of beef, lamb, poultry, and other meats as required for hotel operations. Ensure all meat products are handled, labeled, dated, stored, and rotated in compliance with food safety standards and FIFO procedures. Maintain proper temperature controls during receiving, preparation, and storage processes. Adhere to HACCP principles and the hotel's food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and health regulations. Maintain cleanliness and sanitation of workstations, cutting boards, knives, equipment, and cold-storage areas. Monitor stock levels, report shortages, and assist with inventory counts and stock rotation. Minimize food waste through proper cutting techniques, portion control, and efficient utilization of meat products. Ensure safe use and maintenance of knives, meat slicers, and other equipment. Coordinate with the Executive Chef, Sous Chef, and kitchen team for timely product preparation for daily operations and events. Comply with hotel policies, procedures, and standards, including occupational health and safety requirements. Perform other related duties as assigned by the Executive Chef or authorized supervisor. Required Competencies Proficiency in meat preparation and portion control. Strong understanding and compliance with food safety and hygiene standards. Ability to perform quality control and freshness inspections. Awareness of waste reduction and cost control. Safe handling of knives and kitchen equipment. Effective teamwork and communication skills. Good time management and attention to detail. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should have 0-1 years of relevant experience. A strong understanding of meat preparation techniques and adherence to food safety protocols are essential for this role. Health, Safety, and Hygiene Standards The successful candidate must comply with all hotel food safety policies, HACCP procedures, personal hygiene requirements, and applicable local regulations. All equipment and work areas must be maintained in a clean, safe, and hygienic condition at all times. Performance Indicators Consistent compliance with food safety and hygiene standards. Accuracy of meat cuts and portion sizes. Minimization of meat wastage. Maintenance of product quality and freshness. Timely completion of preparation requirements. Compliance with inventory and storage procedures.

f93771907427039a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث محل خرازة للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان مستوى عالٍ من رضا العملاء من خلال تقديم خدمة مبيعات ممتازة والمساهمة في نمو إيرادات الشركة. الغرض من الوظيفة يتمثل الغرض الأساسي لهذا الدور في تعزيز تجربة العملاء داخل المتجر، والمحافظة على بيئة تسوق منظمة وجذابة، والمساعدة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات لزيادة نمو الشركة وإيراداتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء وتوجيههم بفعالية داخل أقسام المعرض. تقديم معلومات دقيقة وشاملة عن المنتجات المعروضة، بما في ذلك الأسعار والميزات وخدمات ما بعد البيع. التجاوب مع استفسارات العملاء بخصوص الخدمات والمنتجات المتوفرة في المعرض. إجراء مقارنات بين المنتجات المختلفة لتسليط الضوء على الميزات التنافسية وتشجيع العملاء على الشراء. اتباع الإجراءات الصحيحة لإدارة صناديق البيع بكفاءة. الالتزام بسياسات وتعليمات المنشأة. المشاركة في عمليات الجرد الدوري والسنوي للمخزون. العمل على زيادة مبيعات الفرع وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وبناء علاقات إيجابية معهم. مهارات تواصل قوية وقدرة على الإقناع. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات التشغيلية. بيئة العمل يعمل البائع في بيئة بيع بالتجزئة ديناميكية في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق أهداف المبيعات ورضا العملاء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

f949333771913b61.description: About Roche At Roche, individuals are valued and respected, enabling personal and professional growth. The company focuses on preventing, stopping, and curing diseases, aiming to ensure access to healthcare for current and future generations. Roche operates with the principle that every voice contributes to its mission. Initially, this is an individual contributor role with the potential to build and lead a team in the future. The lead will empower commercial, access, regulatory, and medical teams to deliver innovations to patients. f9501ce740795272.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان كفاءة وسلامة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف.

f9b8c9ed9622dd61.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في ضبا، تبوك. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لأعمال التمديدات، ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إصلاحها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد قوائم مفصلة ببنود القطع، المواد، والمعدات الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواصفات. تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية المختلفة ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها بفعالية. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية عمل المعدات وكفاءتها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. متطلبات الخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة والغاز. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بمنفذ ضباء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. نوع الوظيفة دوام كامل. الموقع ضبا، تبوك.

f9c20152c4156719.description: About Bouygues Construction Bouygues Travaux Publics KSA, part of Bouygues Travaux Publics, specializes in civil engineering, underground tunneling, and complex structures. The company delivers major infrastructure and land-use projects globally, with a commitment to sustainable construction, diversity, and welcoming talent from all backgrounds. The Role of Project Data Senior Engineer As a Project Data Senior Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and validating design data throughout the project lifecycle. This contract position is based in Al Ula and involves ensuring the integrity and completeness of design packages for procurement and construction, supporting various project teams with accurate data analysis and reporting. Key Responsibilities Review incoming excavation and building design packages to ensure data completeness, model integrity, geometry, quantities, and technical specifications are suitable for procurement and construction. Extract and validate Material Take-Offs (MTO), including excavation volumes, ground support systems, rockbolts, steel sets, structural, architectural, and MEP quantities. Develop and maintain an integrated 3D design model, incorporating design updates and monitoring design maturity at key project stages. Track quantity changes resulting from design revisions and provide clear variance analyses to Technical, Estimating, Finance, Procurement, and Operations teams. Identify design inconsistencies, clashes, missing information, and multidisciplinary coordination issues; escalate critical items to the Technical Director. Maintain traceability of design assumptions, model versions, RFIs, and design changes, ensuring all information is appropriately documented and controlled. Support the preparation of cost baselines, work-package scopes, and procurement requirements through accurate and validated design data. Contribute to the definition of design interfaces, handover points, trade sequencing, and construction phasing requirements. Develop 4D model outputs, visualizations, and construction sequence simulations to support planning, site access, and delivery coordination. Coordinate the integration of survey and as-built information into the project model. Compare as-built conditions and quantities against design and contractual requirements, highlighting discrepancies and supporting remedial-work or change assessments. Work closely with Design, Technical, Construction, Procurement, Planning, and Commercial teams to ensure design information is translated into construction-ready deliverables. Work Environment and Collaboration This role requires close collaboration with various internal teams including Design, Technical, Construction, Procurement, Planning, and Commercial. The Project Data Senior Engineer will play a central role in ensuring that design information is accurately translated into actionable deliverables for construction projects in Al Ula. Application Process Candidates interested in this contract position are encouraged to apply.

f9d1e9c0880ebf6e.description: نبذة عن مهندس إدارة المشاريع تبحث شركة الخليج المتطورة للصيانة والنظافة عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على وضع وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع المتكاملة، وإدارة التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان التنفيذ الفعال للمشاريع من خلال التخطيط الدقيق، وإدارة الموارد والتكاليف، وتحديد الجداول الزمنية، بالإضافة إلى توفير أساس قوي لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع لجميع الأطراف المعنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع التعرف على الجوانب الفنية المحددة لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المتخصصة، وتحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة لكل منها. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف والمهندسين المعنيين بالتنفيذ ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات فعالة مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع بشكل دوري. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط، التنظيم، وإدارة الموارد. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور للتقديم.

The company delivers innovative real estate solutions for public-benefit projects across the Riyadh region, focusing on creating long-term value for communities and stakeholders. Riyadh Holding is committed to enhancing quality of life and enabling thriving cities through service-oriented developments, the activation of public spaces and parks, and the advancement of logistics and mobility solutions, contributing to sustainable urban growth and the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. The Role of EPMO Manager Riyadh Holding Company is seeking an Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) Manager to oversee and support the EPMO function. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves ensuring effective governance, monitoring, and reporting of strategic initiatives and enterprise projects. The EPMO Manager will support portfolio alignment with corporate strategy, monitor project performance against approved scope, timelines, budgets, and KPIs, and provide timely insights for management decision-making. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain EPMO governance frameworks, methodologies, policies, and project management standards. Maintain a consolidated view of strategic initiatives, programs, and enterprise projects, ensuring alignment with corporate strategic objectives. Monitor project scope, schedules, budgets, milestones, dependencies, KPIs, and overall delivery progress. Consolidate project and portfolio performance data and prepare periodic management reports and dashboards. Monitor and escalate project and portfolio risks, issues, dependencies, delays, and significant budget variances. Coordinate project stage reviews, governance checkpoints, health checks, and change requests, ensuring compliance with approved EPMO standards. Support resource and capacity planning and monitor project budgets against approved allocations and actual expenditure. Coordinate with business units, project managers, and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely project updates, reporting, and effective application of EPMO methodologies. Identify opportunities to continuously improve EPMO processes, tools, templates, reporting, and project management capabilities. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in project management, EPMO functions, or a related field. Work Setting This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The EPMO Manager will operate within a dynamic environment, collaborating with various business units and stakeholders to achieve strategic objectives.

f9fee8fd5e15a58c.description: About LotFair LotFair supports organizations in enhancing performance by streamlining processes and implementing systems for financial consolidation, reporting, integrated business planning, forecasting, and data analytics. The company focuses on enabling data-driven decision-making and improving financial visibility across enterprises. LotFair assists clients in modernizing their Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) capabilities to drive efficiency and control, working closely with stakeholders to deliver solutions that improve accuracy, transparency, and speed in financial and operational processes. Role Overview This is a full-time, on-site role for an EPM Developer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The EPM Developer will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining EPM solutions that support financial consolidation, planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes. This position is open to Saudi Nationals with 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field, offering a salary of 7,000-8,000 SAR per month. Key Responsibilities Gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders to translate them into effective EPM solutions. Configure EPM applications and develop data models, reports, and dashboards. Ensure data integrity and system performance, monitoring and troubleshooting issues as they arise. Collaborate with finance, IT, and business stakeholders to align technical solutions with business needs. Document system configurations and support testing, deployment, and user training activities. Develop and maintain planning, reporting, and analytics applications, specifically on the Board platform. Participate in client workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and solution discussions. Prepare functional and technical documentation, presentations, and project deliverables. Provide user support, training, and knowledge transfer. Recommend enhancements to improve system usability and efficiency. Required Attributes Consulting and customer-focused mindset. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Demonstrated business analysis and requirements-gathering capabilities. Leadership potential with the ability to take initiative and drive outcomes. Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills. Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and business processes. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position located in Riyadh, requiring the EPM Developer to work directly from the company's premises. The role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery and continuous improvement initiatives.

Establish and standardize trial/demo processes, ensuring high-quality technical execution and maximizing conversion from evaluation to commercial success. Develop standardized customer installation/training SOP procedures to improve customer experience, technical adoption, and long-term satisfaction. Develop and coach distributor application specialists across the Middle East to ensure consistent technical support and customer experience. Allocate and prioritize Application Specialist resources across regions in close collaboration with the Head of Sales to maximize business impact and align with commercial priorities. f900764fff02b783.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها، لضمان الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المرافق. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجداول الزمنية للخدمات اليومية والموسمية. تخطيط وإعداد الجداول الزمنية الخاصة بأعمال الموظفين. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أدائهم لواجباتهم، بما في ذلك مسح الأتربة، كنس الأرضيات، تنظيف دورات المياه، وتغيير الشراشف. الحث على تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي المعتمدة. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى، والحفاظ عليه. ضمان اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإشراف على خدمات التنظيف والتدبير. القدرة على إدارة وتنسيق فرق العمل بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف التنظيف والتدبير ضمن فريق في المرافق التجارية التابعة للشركة في أبها. يتطلب الدور التواجد بدوام كامل لضمان الإشراف المستمر على جودة الخدمات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على تنظيم وتخطيط المهام بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع فريق العمل والإدارة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والنظافة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال الصيانة والتشغيل. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

f92fb5cd05e09d24.description: About Group AMANA Group AMANA is a regional leader in industrial construction, specializing in design-build solutions for over three decades. The company focuses on intelligent construction solutions and provides turnkey solutions for fast-track projects. Group AMANA is committed to fostering an inclusive environment and promotes learning and development opportunities for its employees. Job Summary Group AMANA is seeking a Sr. Technical Engineer MEP to support projects in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves reviewing and coordinating mechanical designs, specifications, drawings, and BIM models to ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable codes, quality standards, and client expectations. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership, resolve engineering challenges, and drive multidisciplinary coordination throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Lead the review and validation of mechanical designs, engineering calculations, specifications, and technical documentation to ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable codes, and industry standards. Develop, review, and approve detailed design drawings, shop drawings, material submittals, technical reports, and engineering deliverables. Coordinate with the BIM team for timely model updates, clash resolution, and multidisciplinary integration. Review and approve designs prepared by third parties, ensuring compatibility with architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines. Lead the preparation and timely issuance of IFP/IFF (Issued for Production/Fabrication), shop drawings, and SFC (Issued for Construction) drawings in line with project schedules. Perform engineering calculations, technical assessments, and design reviews to ensure the integrity, functionality, and constructability of mechanical systems. Provide technical support to site and construction teams, conducting site visits and resolving engineering and execution-related challenges. Coordinate with clients, consultants, subcontractors, procurement teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution. Prepare technical scopes and bid packages for materials and subcontractors, review engineering aspects of prequalification documents and material submissions, and support procurement activities. Monitor project progress and ensure adherence to quality, safety, cost, and schedule objectives. Identify and propose value engineering opportunities during the execution stage to optimize project cost, efficiency, and performance. Manage engineering activities across multiple projects and act as the primary technical focal point during meetings and stakeholder discussions. Mentor and guide Junior Technical Engineers, promoting technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and professional development. Maintain accurate engineering records, documentation, and project correspondence. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in a technical engineering role. Demonstrated ability to lead the review and validation of mechanical designs and technical documentation. Experience with BIM coordination and multidisciplinary integration. Strong understanding of applicable codes and industry standards. Core Values Group AMANA values employees who embody the following principles: Team Player Reliable Clear Communicator Decision-maker based on Understanding Accountable Integrity-driven Human-driven Adaptable and Agile Application Process Group AMANA is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

The Role of Testing & Commissioning Engineer The Testing & Commissioning Engineer is a full-time, on-site position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This role involves planning, performing, and documenting electrical testing activities for power systems, substations, and related equipment, ensuring strict compliance with technical standards and project specifications. Key Responsibilities Reviewing drawings and technical documentation. Preparing detailed test procedures. Conducting functional and performance tests on electrical systems. Participating in pre-commissioning and commissioning activities. Diagnosing and resolving technical issues. Coordinating effectively with project teams and external vendors. Supporting the operational handover of completed projects. Providing technical input on aspects of safety, quality, and reliability. Contributing to the continuous improvement of testing processes. Maintaining clear and accurate reports for both clients and internal stakeholders. Work Environment This is an on-site role requiring full-time presence in Al Khobar. The engineer will work within project teams, collaborating with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

f997004390816993.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Director of Operations to lead the strategic business aspects of hotel operations. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and Ad Dir'iyah and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The Director of Operations will oversee various departments including Front Office, Recreation/Health Club, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage/Culinary, and Engineering/Maintenance, working with department heads to develop and implement strategies aligned with brand service initiatives. Key Responsibilities Function as the strategic business leader for hotel operations, ensuring alignment with brand service strategy and initiatives. Develop and implement property-wide strategies to meet or exceed customer and employee needs and expectations, ensuring a return on investment. Demonstrate and communicate key drivers of guest satisfaction, analyze service issues, and identify trends to achieve goals. Monitor hotel operations sales performance against budget, review financial statements, and coach the operations team to manage occupancy, rate, wages, and controllable expenses effectively. Champion the brand’s service vision, ensuring alignment among hotel leadership teams and developing systems for employees to understand guest satisfaction results. Review guest feedback with the leadership team, respond to and handle guest problems, and maintain visibility to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels. Facilitate the development of creative solutions to improve guest satisfaction, ensure fair and equitable treatment of employees, and foster commitment to excellent service. Set goals and expectations for direct reports, conduct annual performance appraisals, and ensure property policies and disciplinary procedures adhere to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs). Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in hotel operations or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage profitability, including monitoring sales performance and controlling expenses. Experience in leading and developing operational and departmental teams. Proven capability in managing the guest experience and addressing feedback effectively. Strong understanding of human resources activities, including performance management and employee relations. Each hotel and resort serves as a unique expression of its locale, providing a portal to the destination’s cultural charms and treasures. This role is suited for individuals who appreciate evocative storytelling, possess a keen interest in destination heritage, and are committed to delivering genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality.

f942cdb8a8832d53.description: About the Role WSP in the Middle East is seeking a Principal / Associate Electrical Engineer with extensive airport project experience to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the design and delivery of complex aviation and industrial buildings, including aircraft maintenance hangars, engine/APU workshops, and large-scale flight catering environments. The successful candidate will act as the electrical technical authority, overseeing power distribution, ELV systems, airfield/ground systems interfaces, and hazardous-area electrical design, delivering concept-to-IFC solutions aligned with stringent safety, operational, and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead electrical design from feasibility and Basis of Design (BoD) through detailed design, tender, and construction support for aviation facilities. Develop electrical power strategies for large-scale facilities, including MV/LV distribution, redundancy, load management, earthing, and control philosophies, balancing reliability, safety, and energy performance (IEC/NFPA context). Engineer electrical systems for hazardous operations such as paint booths/rooms, fuel-cell maintenance areas, and welding zones, ensuring ATEX/IECEx compliance and coordination with mechanical ventilation and controls. Design and specify power systems for aviation facilities, including transformers, generators, UPS, distribution boards, and backup systems for mission-critical operations. Integrate electrical utilities across MRO and workshop environments, including ground power units (GPU), PCA interfaces, process equipment loads, and coordination with mechanical, fire/life safety, and control systems. Shape electrical systems for catering facilities, focusing on resilient power distribution for kitchens, cold-chain systems, and hygienic areas aligned with HACCP/ISO 22000 requirements. Deliver BIM-led coordination (Revit/Navisworks) across architecture, structures, MEP, and specialist systems, leading clash resolution and model QA. Perform calculations and studies, including load estimation, cable sizing, protection coordination, short-circuit analysis, and lighting design. Author technical documents such as BoD, load schedules, single-line diagrams (SLDs), specifications, and commissioning plans. Mentor and review engineers/designers, leading design reviews, HAZOPs, and constructability/operability workshops. Engage stakeholders (airlines, MROs, airport operators, and authorities) to secure approvals and ensure smooth project delivery. Lead retrofit, refurbishment, and brownfield upgrades in operational airport environments, assessing existing systems, planning phased upgrades, and integrating new systems with minimal disruption while improving capacity, compliance, and energy performance. Key Systems and Domains Hangars & Workshops: MV/LV distribution, ground power units (GPU), PCA electrical interfaces, high-bay lighting, emergency power, earthing and bonding for aircraft safety, and hangar door electrics. Paint/Corrosion Control: Hazardous-area electrical systems, explosion-proof equipment, interlocks, LEL monitoring interfaces, and ATEX/IECEx compliance coordinated with ventilation and controls. Welding & Fabrication: Power distribution for welding equipment, equipment earthing, task lighting, and integration with extraction/LEV systems aligned with OSHA/ACGIH guidance. Power Systems: Transformers, generators, UPS, LV panels, and distribution networks designed for redundancy, resilience, and mission-critical operations. Catering Facilities: Resilient power supply for kitchens, cold rooms/freezers, food processing areas, and hygienic zoning aligned with HACCP/ISO 22000 requirements. ELV & Controls: Fire alarm systems (NFPA 72), ICT, security (CCTV/access control), structured cabling, and BMS/SCADA integration for operational monitoring and control. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, with a significant focus on airport projects and aviation facilities. Demonstrated expertise in power distribution, ELV systems, airfield/ground systems interfaces, and hazardous-area electrical design. Proficiency in BIM-led coordination using Revit/Navisworks. Strong understanding of relevant international standards and regulations (*, IEC/NFPA, ATEX/IECEx, HACCP/ISO 22000, OSHA/ACGIH). Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time position within WSP in the Middle East. The successful candidate will join a global team of over 69,000 employees, contributing to projects that make a difference in communities worldwide. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply today.

f95e3c76937fe2d0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن أخصائي موازنة مالية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى وضع وتنفيذ سياسات إدارة الأصول والخصوم ورأس المال، بهدف تحسين الموازنات المالية للمؤسسات ودعم أهدافها الاستراتيجية والمالية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة وتقييم موازنات المؤسسات، وفهم طبيعة وحجم الأصول والخصوم، وتقييم المخاطر المحتملة مثل مخاطر السيولة والائتمان ورأس المال. تحديد وقياس حالات العجز بين الأصول والخصوم الناتجة عن فجوات التمويل والاستحقاقات، وتحديد أساليب موازنة التدفقات النقدية والمعدلات وغيرها من العوامل. وضع سياسات إدارة الموازنة المالية، بما في ذلك تقييد أحجام فئات الأصول والخصوم الكبرى، وتحديد مزيج الموازنة المالية، وتحديد نسب السيولة المستهدفة، والإشراف على تنفيذ هذه السياسات. ضمان التزام الموازنة المالية باللوائح المتعلقة بمتطلبات رأس المال ونسب السيولة ونسب التركيز والتمويل. دراسة حجم الإنفاق الكلي ومصادر التمويل والإيرادات المتوقعة، وإعداد كشوف الموازنة السنوية باستخدام النماذج والبنود المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الموازنة المالية أو ما يعادلها. فهم جيد لمبادئ إدارة الأصول والخصوم وإدارة رأس المال. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتحديد المخاطر. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، كتابية وشفوية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو والتطور المهني. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة معين للموارد البشرية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

f965040913257ca4.description: About SITA SITA provides technology and communication innovations to the global air travel industry, supporting operations at 95% of international airports. The company works with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, focusing on delivering solutions and technology to maintain operational efficiency. SITA is recognized as a Great Place to Work® by 79% of its employees and is certified in most of its growing locations. The Associate Project Manager Role SITA is seeking an Associate Project Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves driving projects that enhance travel safety and ease for customers, while also promoting sustainability and cultural diversity. The position operates within a fast-paced, dynamic, and agile global environment that values cultural differences. Candidates should possess a results-oriented approach and the ability to motivate team members, appreciate diverse perspectives, and manage projects across various locations. Proficiency in stakeholder engagement, scheduling, quality assurance, and people relations is required, along with a commitment to creating sustainable value for customers and the environment. Key Responsibilities Manage projects of varying scope and complexity throughout their life cycle, from inception to closure. This includes managing change, mitigating risks, and delivering results to stakeholders and customers. Track project activities against planned schedules, taking corrective action for any deviations. Communicate regularly with team members, management, stakeholders, and customers to ensure continuous understanding and alignment on project progress. Proactively collaborate with customers and their teams to ensure project goals and objectives are met, and customer needs and expectations are consistently addressed. Handle project administration, including developing communication strategy plans, designing resource and project plans, providing status reports, submitting and tracking change requests, tracking risks and issues, providing variance reports, and submitting Steering Committee reports and lessons learned. Incorporate sustainability into project planning by considering long-term impacts and promoting sustainable behaviors among project teams through goal setting and metrics. Collaborate and manage all customer-facing projects using the SITA Project Management Tool, ensuring consistent and accurate project information, documents, and reports in compliance with established governance. Drive project profitability and work with the Project Financial Controller to manage the project P&L in accordance with the Business Case. Required Experience and Skills 5-10 years of experience in project management. Demonstrated ability to motivate team members and appreciate different perspectives. Proficiency in stakeholder engagement, scheduling, quality assurance, and people relations. Strong written communication skills for project documentation and reporting. f99b9058ee57ce17.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز كنان المستقبل للرعاية النهارية عن أخصائي علاج طبيعي للانضمام إلى فريقه في الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة الحالات المرضية، ووضع خطط العلاج الطبيعي، ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج للمرضى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الحالة المرضية للمصابين وتحديد برنامج العلاج الطبيعي المناسب. وضع خطة وبرنامج العلاج الطبيعي ومتابعة تنفيذهما، مع تسجيل البيانات العلاجية بشكل دقيق. تحديد التمارين والحركات التقويمية اللازمة وتحديد معدلات تكرارها بالتنسيق مع الطبيب المعالج. تدليك المرضى لتحسين أداء عضلات الجسم المصاب وتدريبهم على استخدام الأثقال وبكرات الشد والآلات الرياضية وأجهزة العوارض. تنفيذ الحركات الأرضية لتقوية عضلات الأطراف والظهر والعنق، وتدريب المصاب وذويه على التمارين الواجب متابعتها من المنزل. ضبط وتنظيم الأجهزة المستخدمة في العلاج الطبيعي لضمان فعاليتها وسلامتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالعلاج الطبيعي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال العلاج الطبيعي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريب للمرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العلاج الطبيعي بدوام كامل في مركز كنان المستقبل للرعاية النهارية بمدينة الباحة، ضمن بيئة داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

f9af05d85752e471.description: تعلن شركتنا عن توفر فرص وظيفية لشغل وظائف مبيعات في قطاع الاتصالات بمختلف فروعنا بالرياض، وذلك للكوادر الوطنية الطموحة. الشروط والمؤهلات المطلوبة: الجنسـ ـية: للسـ ـعوديين فقط. الخبرة: خبرة لا تقل عن سنة في مجال المبيعات (الأولوية لمن لديهم خبرة سابقة في قطاع الاتصالات). العمر: لا يقل عن 20 عاماً. التفرغ: تفرغ تام للعمل (أن لا يكون المتقدم طالباً). المهارات: لباقة وحسن تعامل مع العملاء والقدرة على التواصل الفعال. الفروع المتاحة: فرع لبن فرع العزيزية فرع العارض فرع الياسمين

f9b70f4323db2dbc.description: About the Role KBR Saudi Arabia is seeking a Project – Construction Director to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position reports to the Programme Director and is responsible for project oversight from the PMO level, covering both pre and post-contract award phases. The role involves managing a masterplan for executive commercial, planning, and risk reporting oversight within a matrix PMO organization. Role Objective The primary objective of this role is to ensure controlled delivery, recommend appropriate commercial strategies, and manage projects through pre and post-contract stages. The Project – Construction Director will provide accurate status reports to facilitate timely decisions, prevent schedule slippage and cost overruns, and produce comprehensive close-out reports for each project. Key Responsibilities Provide oversight and coordination with PMCs to develop, implement, and govern standard reporting formats for quality, commercial, planning, and safety. Validate progress throughout the pre and post-contract stage gate process. Validate earned progress against baseline schedules and coordinate with PMCs for project cost report preparation and validation. Oversee and validate PMC preparation of annual program-wide budgets and monthly cashflow reports. Participate in the development of value engineering proposals and value-adding initiatives. Identify and report risks to scope that may result in potential growth trends. Work closely with PMCs and PMO planners to perform forecasts for milestone completion. Support portfolio-wide risk management services to ensure effective governance, decision-making, and assurance, aligning with approved risk policies and frameworks. Collaborate with PMCs to perform stakeholder identification, analysis, and engagement planning, and identify risks to effective stakeholder management and third-party coordination. Coordinate with PMCs to validate the creation, accurate reporting, and management of the Approvals Register. Coordinate with PMCs to identify health, safety, environmental, and quality compliance risks and prepare mitigation plans. Coordinate with PMCs to report risks and develop mitigation strategies for project completion, conditions for taking-over certificates, and defect completion. Coordinate between PMCs and the Client for the management of operational readiness, asset transfer, and the defects liability period. Facilitate knowledge transfer to the Client and PMCs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in project and construction management. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects from pre to post-contract award. Experience operating within a matrix PMO organization. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring direct responsibility for oversight of delivery while collaborating with functional members across commercial, planning, and risk departments. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role.

f9d17db78920991a.description: About the Role Mace is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing and potentially leading the implementation and delivery of risk services for commissions, while also providing line management leadership and guidance to other team members within the PMO and Planning Centre of Excellence and assigned Hub. Key Responsibilities Champion safety, wellbeing, inclusivity, and responsible delivery across all projects. Deliver projects through clear planning, robust quality systems, and strong stakeholder collaboration. Supervise change and commercial performance with integrity. Lead teams to achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), share best practices, and develop potential within Mace. Lead risk management frameworks, strategies, and performance for assigned commissions. Partner with clients, consultants, and contractors to manage risks, mitigations, and opportunities. Deliver workshops, Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA), reporting, and assurance in line with Mace and client requirements. Mentor teams, integrate PMO/planning disciplines, and provide support. Core Principles and Accountabilities Safety First: Promote Mace's Safety First value, demonstrate visible safety behaviors, share lessons learned, and utilize safety moments and Mace's HSW framework to support staff wellbeing. Possess technical expertise in local health and safety regulations relevant to the project portfolio. Client Focus: Ensure robust quality systems are in place and managed for service excellence. Manage project delivery from inception through design, planning, procurement, and construction phases, adhering to the overall program and agreed milestones. Manage tasks and deliverables in support of senior leaders and project teams for timely and accurate project delivery. Integrity: Manage project budgets, identify risks, challenges, and mitigations. Support the long-term development of the function or Business Unit to ensure a sustainable future. Commit to making a positive impact for people, clients, and the planet, and hold others accountable for upholding Mace values. Opportunity for People: Manage design and wider consultant teams collaboratively for effective completion of responsibilities. Lead and manage the project team and stakeholders to achieve strategic project KPIs. Actively network, innovate, and seek best practices, leveraging knowledge from Mace Group, Centres of Excellence, Mace Way Control Centre, and Knowledge Hub. Required Qualifications and Experience Extensive experience delivering a range of project risk management services on major construction projects. Experience in effective risk leadership on complex construction projects. Experience in setting up effective risk management/assurance frameworks/strategies. Comprehensive knowledge of risk tools, techniques, and software (*, Active Risk Manager, riskHive, atrisk, Primavera Risk Analyser). Deep domain knowledge of providing risk leadership in one or more sectors (*, rail, highways, nuclear, public sector, hospitals). Good understanding of construction projects, dependencies, and interfaces within the project lifecycle. Skills and Attributes Ability to manage activities with significant uncertainty of solution or outcome. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to form effective working relationships. Ability to collaborate with and influence others. Proven ability to articulate complex information and ideas for a non-technical audience. Ability to work in a highly pressurized environment, managing multiple priorities. Ability to manage, influence, and negotiate with senior stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and ability to 'deep dive' into topics. Commercial awareness and business development skills, including bids/winning work. Effective communication and engagement skills, with the ability to persuade/influence colleagues and stakeholders. Effective networking skills. Ability to contribute to the establishment of high-performing teams. Ability to lead and influence others. Ability to manage challenging behaviors and relationships while securing a positive outcome. Resilient and robust in the face of challenging situations. Flexible, pragmatic, and adaptable.

f9d4bb0a1b84d791.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking a Viral Vector Staff Scientist to join its Bio-Medical platform in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves designing, producing, and delivering high-quality viral vectors, such as AAVs and Lentivirus, to support advanced research within KAUST and the broader region. The Staff Scientist will be instrumental in optimizing production workflows, enhancing vector performance, and ensuring cost-efficiency while upholding strict quality and biosafety standards. Role Responsibilities Collaborate with researchers to identify and implement appropriate viral vector systems for scientific inquiries, supporting high-impact research and publications. Produce high-quality, safe, and effective viral vectors customized for experimental needs and cell-based research applications. Supervise and mentor a laboratory technician, managing daily tasks to ensure timely and high-quality deliverables. Coordinate multiple research projects and timelines to ensure milestones and deliverables are met on schedule. Develop, implement, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure efficiency, reproducibility, and compliance in viral vector production. Ensure Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and maintain a safe working environment in accordance with biosafety regulations and Institutional Biosafety and Ethics Committee (IBEC) guidelines. Integrate laboratory data into the Bio-Medical Platform and collaborate with IT and bioinformatics teams for effective data management, analysis, and reporting. Design and implement new or improved techniques and workflows to address scientific challenges, enhance viral vector performance and throughput, and reduce production costs. Provide advanced training in viral vector production and contribute to building technical expertise among staff. Conduct routine laboratory responsibilities, including procurement, documentation, equipment maintenance, and participation in task forces and institutional committees. Required Qualifications and Experience The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in molecular biology with expertise in viral vector engineering and production. This role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience in a similar capacity. Key Skills Expertise in viral vector engineering and production. Ability to translate complex experimental needs into tailored genetic tools. Proficiency in optimizing and scaling production workflows. Strong understanding of quality and biosafety standards. Experience in supervising technical staff and providing advanced training. Work Environment This full-time position is based at KAUST in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Staff Scientist will work within the Viral Vector Facility (VVF) as part of the Bio-Medical platform, collaborating with researchers and contributing to a dynamic scientific environment. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

f9e1b35b65cf6529.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Work Preparator Mechanical to join their team in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for comprehensive work preparation activities related to mechanical, machining, and repair & maintenance (R&P) work. The role involves defining the scope of work, quantifying tasks, and managing the documentation process from initial client proposals to work completion. Key Responsibilities Adhere to, reinforce, and promote IMI Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality Policies. Conduct detailed evaluations of repair specifications, including itemizing man-hour requirements, total duration of repair, and preparing the Bill of Materials (BOM). Prepare and requisition materials (PRs), manage inter-trade involvements, and facilitate direct purchases as necessary. Issue internal requests and monitor their progress. Ensure timely submission of proposals and drawings for approval before work commencement. Prepare drawings and sketches based on the identified scope of work, secure client signatures, and distribute as required. Liaise with Operations project controls for information and submittals. Assist in bid support as needed. Prepare material lists for job execution and ensure material availability from the warehouse or through direct purchase. Develop detailed job sheets for supervisors and record daily progress. Prepare final work descriptions, including all supplies and man-hours used, for approval by the Senior Superintendent. Update vessel files for Mechanical, Machining, and R&P repairs, capturing actual as-fitted mechanical components for commercial comparison with the initial Scope of Work (SOW). Prepare work completion reports and certificates at the end of repairs. Ensure timely closure of all relevant Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) and Service Receipt Notes (SRNs) for accurate cost capturing and gross margin calculation. Prepare detailed scope of work, work packages, and specifications for outsourced work. Liaise with the engineering team as required. Optimize material usage based on BOM and minimize material waste, focusing on cost cutting and time saving. Provide estimated man-hour details and job progress to Production Planning Units twice weekly. Attend daily onboard meetings with Owner's Representatives and Project Managers to monitor work progress. Develop work descriptions and perform other relevant tasks as directed by management. Internal Working Relationships The role requires regular interaction with all production and project departments within International Maritime Industries. Collaboration with other internal teams will be required as necessary. External Working Relationships Interaction with Classification Societies (Class). Engagement with clients. Communication with vendors, subcontractors, and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

This full-time role focuses on delivering an exceptional customer experience by efficiently handling inquiries and ensuring customer satisfaction. Role Overview The Customer Service Representative is responsible for being the primary point of contact for customers, addressing their needs, and resolving issues promptly. Address customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions, and ensure follow-up until resolution. Build and maintain positive relationships with customers. Ensure overall customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem-solving. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma or higher. This role is critical in overseeing the financial management and asset performance of our film studio facilities, ensuring optimal utilization and financial sustainability. Key Responsibilities Lead financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting for film studio assets, ensuring alignment with corporate goals. Monitor and analyze asset performance, identifying opportunities to improve utilization and financial returns. Develop and implement financial models and reports to support decision-making and strategic planning. Collaborate with operational teams to optimize asset management and support business growth initiatives. Prepare comprehensive financial reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders. Ensure compliance with financial policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. f9735fa37d93ad2f.description: About Assystem Radicon Assystem is an international company focused on accelerating the energy transition globally. With 6,500 employees across 12 countries, Assystem provides engineering and project management services, alongside digital solutions, to optimize complex infrastructure projects. The company has over 55 years of experience in highly regulated sectors and is recognized as a leader in nuclear engineering. Job Summary Assystem Radicon is seeking a Lead Structural Engineer to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role involves leading structural engineering activities across various projects, ensuring technical excellence, and managing the development of structural designs for buildings and infrastructure. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead the structural engineering team, allocating activities and providing technical direction and mentorship. Oversee the development of structural engineering designs, including concept studies, system selection, and detailed design for various structures (concrete, steel, composite, foundations, basements, roofs). Ensure appropriate development, analysis, checking, and technical review of structural analysis models, calculations, and design reports. Lead the preparation and review of structural design basis reports, criteria, calculations, drawings, and tender documentation. Ensure structural designs comply with Saudi Building Code, local authority requirements, and international standards (IBC, ASCE, ACI, AISC, BS EN, Eurocodes). Manage multidisciplinary coordination with architecture, civil, MEP, and other engineering disciplines to integrate structural systems effectively. Lead the implementation of BIM requirements within the structural engineering discipline, coordinating with BIM Managers and participating in clash-detection reviews. Perform technical reviews of structural designs and calculations, ensuring quality, safety, and compliance with Assystem's Quality Management System. Represent the structural engineering discipline in client and stakeholder meetings, presenting design concepts and resolving technical issues. Provide tender and construction support, including reviewing technical submissions, shop drawings, and addressing site structural issues. Identify opportunities for value engineering, structural optimization, and sustainable design solutions, considering embodied carbon and material efficiency. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in structural engineering. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing structural engineering teams and projects. Proficiency in structural analysis and design software. Strong understanding of Saudi Building Code and relevant international structural engineering standards. Experience with BIM and digital engineering tools. Ability to coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. f9e1213e59429197.description: مطلوب مهندس مبيعات – الرياض عن الشركة شركة سعودية راسخة مقرها الرياض، تمتلك خبرة تتجاوز 20 عامًا في السوق السعودي في توريد وتجميع حلول المياه والحريق والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية، ولديها قاعدة أعمال وعلاقات ممتدة مع المقاولين والاستشاريين والمصانع والمشاريع بمختلف القطاعات. نبحث عن مهندس مبيعات محترف ذي خبرة تخصصية مباشرة في مجالات عمل الشركة، يمتلك معرفة قوية بالسوق السعودي وقاعدة عملاء وعلاقات مهنية قائمة، وقادر على الاندماج سريعًا في العمل وتحقيق إضافة بيعية فعلية منذ بداية انضمامه. شرط أساسي للنظر في طلب التوظيف لن يتم النظر في طلبات المتقدمين الذين لم يسبق لهم العمل فعليًا في نفس مجالات عمل الشركة أو في مجالات مرتبطة بها ارتباطًا مباشرًا. المطلوب ليس خبرة عامة في المبيعات، وإنما خبرة ميدانية مثبتة في بيع وتسويق واحد أو أكثر من المجالات التالية: مضخات المياه المنزلية والزراعية والصناعية وغطاسات الآبار. مجموعات رفع وضخ المياه (Booster Pump Sets) وخزانات الضغط. مضخات وأنظمة مكافحة الحريق. المحركات الكهربائية ومحركات الديزل. لوحات التحكم والكهرباء. المعدات الكهروميكانيكية وأعمال MEP. صناديق التروس (Gearboxes) والتوريدات الصناعية ذات الصلة. ويشترط أن يمتلك المرشح قاعدة عملاء وشبكة علاقات مهنية قائمة داخل السوق السعودي مع المقاولين والاستشاريين والمصانع والموزعين والعملاء المستهدفين، وأن يكون قادرًا على توظيف خبرته وعلاقاته لتحقيق نتائج بيعية ملموسة. المهام والمسؤوليات تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية الشهرية والربع سنوية والسنوية وفق خطط الشركة. إدارة وتنمية العملاء الحاليين واستقطاب عملاء وفرص ومشاريع جديدة. توظيف شبكة العلاقات المهنية وقاعدة العملاء في تنمية المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. تطوير العلاقات مع مقاولي MEP والاستشاريين والمطورين والمصانع والمشاريع الزراعية والموزعين. بناء وإدارة ومتابعة Sales Pipeline من تحديد الفرصة والزيارة وحتى تقديم العرض والتفاوض وإغلاق الطلب ومتابعة العميل. تنفيذ زيارات ميدانية منتظمة ومخططة للعملاء والمشاريع. إدارة المناقشات الفنية والتجارية وترشيح المنتجات والحلول المناسبة وفق متطلبات كل تطبيق. إعداد عروض الأسعار والمناقصات بدقة مع مراعاة هوامش الربحية وسياسات التسعير والائتمان. متابعة تسجيل واعتماد الشركة ومنتجاتها لدى المقاولين والاستشاريين والجهات المستهدفة. متابعة المشاريع والمناقصات منذ مراحلها المبكرة وحتى الترسية والتنفيذ. التنسيق مع الإدارات الفنية والمشتريات والمستودعات لضمان مطابقة المواصفات والتوريد في المواعيد المحددة. متابعة التحصيل والالتزام بسياسات الائتمان المعتمدة. متابعة المنافسين والأسعار والمنتجات واتجاهات السوق ورفع المعلومات ذات الصلة للإدارة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير دورية دقيقة ومنتظمة عن الزيارات، والعملاء، والفرص البيعية، والمشاريع، وعروض الأسعار، والطلبات المتوقعة، ونسب الإنجاز والتحصيل. تمثيل الشركة بصورة مهنية لائقة أمام العملاء والاستشاريين وفي الاجتماعات والمعارض والفعاليات. الخبرة والمؤهلات المطلوبة خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في المبيعات الميدانية داخل السوق السعودي في نفس مجالات عمل الشركة أو مجالات مرتبطة بها مباشرة. سجل مثبت في تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية، مع القدرة على توضيح حجم المبيعات السنوية التي سبق تحقيقها. قاعدة عملاء وعلاقات مهنية قائمة وقابلة للتفعيل، ويفضل وجود علاقات قوية في الرياض والمنطقة الوسطى. يفضل بكالوريوس هندسة ميكانيكية أو كهربائية، ويقبل الدبلوم الفني أو المؤهلات الأخرى ذات الصلة بشرط وجود خبرة تخصصية قوية ومثبتة في المجال. معرفة فنية جيدة بالمضخات ومنحنيات الأداء والمحركات وخزانات الضغط وأنظمة رفع المياه ومضخات الحريق. تعد المعرفة بـ NFPA 20 وUL/FM وIEC ومتطلبات SASO وSABER والدفاع المدني السعودي ميزة إضافية. المهارات والسمات الشخصية مظهر مهني لائق وحضور جيد يتناسب مع طبيعة الوظيفة وتمثيل الشركة أمام العملاء. اللباقة وحسن التواصل والقدرة على بناء وإدارة العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض والإقناع وإغلاق المبيعات. التنظيم والدقة والانضباط والمتابعة المستمرة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتحليل
